description: This source file contains extension methods for the Orleans ClientBuilder to add streaming support, including in-memory and persistent stream providers, with configuration options.

classes.name: ClientBuilderStreamingExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure streaming support in Orleans client builders.

methods.name: AddStreaming
methods.description: Adds support for streaming to the Orleans client builder.

methods.name: AddMemoryStreams
methods.description: Adds a new in-memory stream provider with default serializer to the client builder.

methods.name: AddMemoryStreams`1`
methods.description: Generic version to add in-memory stream provider with specified serializer.

methods.name: AddPersistentStreams
methods.description: Adds a persistent streams provider to the client with specified adapter factory and configuration.
